run_aggregate_wdl_bench_results: run aggregate_result.py with a benchmark type arg to parse output_file_* and write aggregated results to a JSON file
run_aggregate_lzbench_results: run aggregate_result.py with lzbench as the arg to parse lzbench output files and write aggregated results
parse_benchmark_output_files: parse benchmark output files matching output_file_* glob pattern and aggregate throughput metrics into a JSON report
aggregate_parse_line_results: aggregate results from parse_line.parse_line across multiple output files and dump sorted JSON to out_<type>.json
aggregate_parse_line_lzbench_results: aggregate results from parse_line.parse_line_lzbench across multiple output files and dump sorted JSON to out_lzbench.json
